QuestInfo.name: [Kerning Tower] Scattered Notes
QuestInfo.0: You meet #bPeri Dotts#k, an ordinary girl at the #rKerning Tower 3F Arts & Entertainment Shops#k. She is completely absorbed in her music. Her quirky qualities make her stand out, but she seems to be in some kind of trouble.
QuestInfo.1: Peri Dotts was a little too focused and lost her notes. You feel bad that her #b#t4036021:##k items scattered all over, so you've decided to help her. Maybe the #r#o4310007##k and #r#o4310008##k nearby have the missing sheets? Go and gather #b15#k of the scattered #b#i4036021:# #t4036021:##k items.
QuestInfo.2: You gathered the #t4036021:# items but couldn't help but peek at the contents. You should still take them to Peri Dotts.

0.msg: Huh? Where did my notes go? They were just here! Nooooo!

1.msg: #b(It seems Peri's #r#i4036021:# #t4036021:#s#k#b have scattered all over. The mischievous notebook monsters around here might have snatched them up.)#k

2.msg: If anyone reads them, I'll simply die! I need to find my #b#i4036021:# #t4036021:#s#k right away...

3.msg: I can help you find your #r#i4036021:# #t4036021:#s#k if you want.

4.msg: You're going to help me find them? Really? The contents are kind of... embarrassing. Please hurry! Someone might find them, and (Gasps) read them!

5.msg: Th-thank you, but I have a request. When you find the \n#b#i4036021:# #t4036021:#s#k, don't look at what's written on them, okay?

yes.0: I'm missing about #b15#k sheets of #b#i4036021:# #t4036021:##k. Please help me find them!

no.0: If you can't help me, then I'll just look for them by myself...

0.msg: All right. That's all 15 of the missing #i4036021:# #t4036021:#. I should bring them back to Peri Dotts. But... why she didn't want anyone seeing them? What terrible secrets do they contain? WHAT FOUL DEED IS SHE SCHEMING?!
Whoops! \n#b(You drop the bundle of #t4036021:# on the floor, exposing their contents.)#k\n Oh no! I hope I don't see what's on these papers when I pick them up...

1.msg: #b(It looks like the notes are full of emotional, soul-bearing lyrics. In the margins there are doodles of various stage costumes, and notes on choreography.)#k\n Oh. That's what she meant by embarrassing...

default.0: I'm missing about #b15#k sheets of #b#i4036021:# #t4036021:##k. Please help me find them!
